🔧 Service Worker Fix

Problem: The service worker is caching API requests and causing FetchEvent.respondWith errors.

Automatic Fix

Click the button below to unregister the service worker:

Manual Fix (If Automatic Doesn't Work)

  1. Open DevTools: Cmd + Option + I (Mac) or F12 (Windows)
  2. Go to Application tab
  3. Click Service Workers in left sidebar
  4. Click Unregister on any service workers listed
  5. Click Clear storage button
  6. Hard refresh: Cmd + Shift + R (Mac) or Ctrl + Shift + R (Windows)
  7. Try logging in again with your admin key
